import numpy as np
def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    points = np.zeros((n_runs, 60, 3), dtype=float)
    # Clamp start inside terrain box
    start_lat, start_lon = terrain.clamp(start[0], start[1])
    points[:, 0, 0] = start_lat
    points[:, 0, 1] = start_lon
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0.0
    # Staying put means no movement, just time advances linearly from 0 to min(duration_s, 59)
    tvals = np.linspace(0, duration_s, 60)
    points[:, :, 0] = start_lat
    points[:, :, 1] = start_lon
    points[:, :, 2] = tvals
    # Check inside terrain box for all points (all same location)
    ok = terrain.inside(points[:, 0, 0], points[:, 0, 1])
    return points, ok
